prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production particle sprite atlas for the original gothic dungeon game Grimhollow. Create a single square 4 by 4 sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Exactly sixteen independent centered cutouts, each fitting in its own equal cell with generous transparent padding, no touching between cells. Painted high-resolution organic VFX, smoothly antialiased, grayscale ivory/silver so the game can tint them green/violet/gold/red. No solid square backgrounds, no pixel art, no frames, no lettering, no UI symbols. Upper-left row across: a narrow curled grass blade, a fluttering oak-like leaf, a small jagged stone chip, a tiny ragged wood splinter. Second row: curling smoky wisp for a curse (translucent outer curls but visible smoky core), asymmetrical luminous mote with soft halo, compact forked lightning discharge (bright core and pale glow), elongated sparkling ember with wispy trailing tail. Third row: round soft puff of vapor (ragged edges, substantial visible central density, not a ring), irregular glossy fluid droplet, tiny four-point magical glint, short brushstroke of spectral flame. Bottom row: small curved bone shard, feather-light tuft of wool/frost, translucent ripple ring, thin twisted cobweb filament. Each is a single legible physical or magical particle, not a scene or an icon badge. Keep particles approximately centered, all well separated, roughly 60-70% of each cell's width/height. Crisp natural silhouettes and painted texture; softly fading alpha for magical effects. Dark fantasy material treatment without imitating any existing game's assets. True transparent alpha outside each cutout.
